episodes.final_message: With three deadlines today and your study time keeping conversation well below your usual baseline, it's totally normal to feel the weight of it all. If you have a quick moment this evening, sending a short text to a close friend or taking a low-key 15-minute coffee break at Collis might offer a comforting breather.

It sounds like you're navigating a real blizzard of emotions right now, and with three deadlines due today, it's completely understandable that things feel heavy. Maybe try picking just one small part of a CS 50 task or a FILM 51 reading for a single 25-minute block, then giving yourself a little breather. And please remember, if things feel too heavy, you can always reach out to CAPS or a peer line just to have a gentle space to talk.
